2: For the music director; according to The Doe of the Dawn. A psalm of David. My God, my God why have you forsaken me? Why are you far from helping me, far from the words of my groaning?
3: O my God, I call by day and you do not answer, and by night but I have no rest.
4: Yet you are holy, enthroned on the praises of Israel.
5: Our ancestors trusted you; they trusted and you delivered them.
6: They cried to you and were saved; they trusted you and were not ashamed.
7: But I am a worm and not a man, scorned by humankind and despised by people.
8: All who see me mock me. They open wide their lips; they shake the head, saying:
9: “⌞He trusts Yahweh⌟. Let him rescue him. Let him deliver him because he delights in him.”
10: Yet you took me from the belly; you made me trust while on my mother’s breasts.
11: On you I was cast from the womb. From my mother’s belly you have been my God.
12: Do not be far from me because trouble is near; because there is no helper.
13: Many bulls have encircled me; mighty bulls of Bashan have surrounded me.
14: They open their mouth against me like a lion tearing and roaring.
15: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax; it is melted ⌞within me⌟.
16: My strength is dry like a potsherd, and my tongue is sticking to my jaws; and you have placed me in the dust of death.
17: Because dogs have surrounded me; a gang of evildoers has encircled me. Like the lion they are at my hands and my feet.
18: I can count all my bones; they gaze, they look at me.
19: They divide my garments among them, and for my clothing they cast lots.
20: But you, O Yahweh, do not remain distant. O my help, hasten to help me.
21: Rescue my life from the sword, my only life from the power of the dogs.
22: Save me from the mouth of the lion, and from the horns of the wild oxen answer me.
23: I will tell your name to my brothers; inside the assembly I will praise you.
24: You who revere Yahweh, praise him! Glorify him, all you seed of Jacob, and be in awe of him, all you seed of Israel,
25: because he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, and has not hid his face from him; but he listened to him when he cried for help.
26: From you is my praise. In the great assembly, I will pay my vows before those who revere him.
27: The afflicted will eat and will be satisfied. Those who seek him will praise Yahweh. May your heart live forever.
28: All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to Yahweh. All the families of the nations will worship before you.
29: Because the kingship belongs to Yahweh, and he rules over the nations.
30: All the ⌞healthy ones⌟ of the earth will eat and worship. Before him all of those descending into the dust will kneel, even he who cannot keep his soul alive.
31: Descendants will serve him. Regarding the Lord, it will be told to the next generation.
32: They will come and tell his saving deeds to a people yet to be born, that he has done it.
